'''Guermessa''' was one of the three [[moon]]s of the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]], along with [[Ghomrassen]] and [[Chenini]].<ref name="AbEverything" />

{{Moon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
"Guermessa" is a town in the province of [[Wikipedia:Tataouine|Tataouine]], Tunisia.
